verdict_scope: A-INDEX-01 correction and focused regressions in the exact review2 freeze; accept for Coordinator integration decision. No runtime-compatibility or end-to-end performance validation implied.

finding_disposition.reason: The builder rejects every existing final path using lexists, without resolving away final-component links. It then opens with xb, so a hard link or independent output created after the preflight causes exclusive creation to fail rather than truncate an existing inode. The failure path returns2 and emits no success receipt. Fresh output creation remains supported.
finding_disposition.policy: Existing outputs, including unrelated caches, must be rejected. Rebuild to a fresh path.

Historical approximately8.3x fixed-file discovery and two-query amortization must not be represented as measurements of review2 or overall recovery work.
